_comment: Declared registry of strategy-104 config profiles + manifests that scheduled live / shadow / A-B paths can load. The config-artifact-path gate (scripts/check_config_artifact_paths.py) validates EVERY profile listed here, not just the live config: a bad artifact path in a shadow / A-B profile matters because those profiles carry the ../../ PatchTST checkpoint as their PRIMARY scorer (the live config carries it as a shadow). Validating only strategy_config.json would miss the escape on the scheduled shadow / A-B load paths. Add a profile here whenever a new scheduled path can load one; codex CR on umbrella PR #525.

_shapes.strategy_config: kernel strategy config: ranking.panel_scoring.{artifact_path, global_calibration.artifact_path, shadow_models[*].artifact_path} + panel_ltr.artifact_path

profiles.loaded_by: readonly shadow path (PatchTST primary, XGB shadow)
